cues.text: The takoyaki stand at the Iwatodai Strip Mall. You and an athletic-looking boy in a tracksuit sit side by side on a low ledge, each with a tray of takoyaki, in the middle of an eating race, cramming them in as fast as you can.
The race over, you and Mamoru sit side by side, hunched forward with your elbows on your knees, catching your breath.
Mamoru gets up and runs off.
